description.text: This cultural tour will take you through stunning archaeological sites and colonial gems of the southern valley. From the agricultural terraces of Tipón, through the ancient Wari ruins of Pikillaqta, to the majestic temple of Andahuaylillas, known as the Sistine Chapel of America, every stop is a window onto the history of Peru. Ideal for those looking for an enriching experience close to the city, this tour combines archaeology, architecture and religious art in just half a day.

items: Pick-up from your hotel or from the Plaza de Armas of Cusco at approximately 9:00 AM.
We visit Tipón, an Inca complex with agricultural terraces and an irrigation system that still works, considered a jewel of hydraulic engineering.
We continue to Pikillaqta, a pre-Inca city belonging to the Wari culture, where we observe its urban organization with straight streets, adobe constructions and ceremonial enclosures.
Panoramic stop at the Huacarpay Lagoon, a natural wetland that is home to migratory birds and offers a beautiful view of the valley.
We finish with the visit to Andahuaylillas, home to the church of San Pedro Apóstol, famous for its mural art, gilded ceilings and works of the Cusco School.
Return to the city of Cusco at approximately 2:30 PM.
Tourist transportation
Pick-up at your hotel or downtown Cusco
